original_client_text.markup_text:
4 things I wish I knew before losing 100lbs+:

1. It takes WAY longer than you think.
Weight loss isn’t linear, and slow progress is still progress. The version of you who learns to be patient is the version who keeps it off.

2. The boring stuff is what actually changes you.
Meal prep. Walking. Sleeping. Training. Repeating simple habits even when you’re not motivated. There’s no secret. You just have to keep showing up.

3. Your body will fight you sometimes.
Plateaus happen. Your weight will fluctuate. Some weeks the scale won’t move despite doing everything “right.” It doesn’t mean you’re failing. You have to learn to adjust without giving up.

4. Reaching your goal weight doesn’t magically change everything.
You don’t suddenly arrive at the finish line and never struggle again. You still have to choose yourself every day and build a lifestyle you actually want to maintain.

Follow along for fitness, weight loss & lifestyle content 🤍

#weighlossjourney #fitnessjourney #fyp #lifestylecontent #fitnessmotivation

original_client_text.markup_text:
Happy FRIYAY! I am weighing in every Friday until I lose 100lbs and FAM… we are up a whopping 0.6lbs this week! 🤍

A little period week fluctuation and we are moving right along!! 🙌🏻

Here’s your weekly reminder that NOT every weigh in is going to be a drop and THAT IS OKAY!! I’m really trying to take away the positive and negative emotions that come with stepping on the scale. It’s just DATA. It’s not a reflection of how hard I worked, how well I did, or how much progress I’ve made.

I’m here to normalize the drops, the gains, AND the weeks where nothing changes because weight loss is NOT linear!! 🫶🏻

We keep showing up, we keep doing the things, and we keep pushing forward regardless of what that little number says!!

SEE YOU NEXT FRIYAY!! 💗

Start weight: 250lbs
Current weight: 213.8lbs
Total lost: 36.2lbs

How did your week go?! Are you learning to take the emotion out of the scale too?!

aweme_info.desc: I lost the weight. I regained it. And for years, I thought that meant I’d failed. But losing weight hadn’t changed my relationship with food or how I treated myself. The biggest transformation came when I stopped trying to fix my body and started learning how to care for myself. Eating well. Moving more. Enjoying food. Treating myself with kindness instead of punishment. And realising I deserved that care at every size. Because looking after yourself should never be something you have to earn by losing weight. 💚

original_client_text.markup_text:
I lost the weight. I regained it. And for years, I thought that meant I’d failed.

But losing weight hadn’t changed my relationship with food or how I treated myself.

The biggest transformation came when I stopped trying to fix my body and started learning how to care for myself.

Eating well. Moving more. Enjoying food. Treating myself with kindness instead of punishment.

And realising I deserved that care at every size.

Because looking after yourself should never be something you have to earn by losing weight. 💚

aweme_info.desc: I’m down 181 pounds down today. I immediately texted my niece asking for a redo to go to @Universal Studios Hollywood . A few years ago we went and I fit on one ride comfortably and sat and waited while everyone else enjoyed the rides. I kept a brave face and acted as if I was having the best day of my life because I would never take away from her joy. After I started my weight loss journey I told her once I lost enough weight that I wanted to go back and enjoy that day with her like I always wanted to. Now I think I’m ready to try again! I’m nervous to be honest if I will fit but only one way to find out. Time to start planning! #fitnessjourney #fitnessinspiration #gymmotivation #bodytransformation #looseskin

Day 662.

Two things can be true at once: weight loss can be simple on paper and still be incredibly hard in real life.

Sometimes the answer isn’t another diet, another workout plan, or someone telling you to “just be more disciplined.”

Sometimes the real work is figuring out what keeps making it so hard for YOU to stay consistent in the first place.

Your habits. Your patterns. Your environment. Your mindset. Your life.

Once you understand those pieces, you can stop trying to force yourself into somebody else’s strategy and start building one that actually works for you long-term.

Simple doesn’t always mean easy. But hard doesn’t mean impossible either.

🙏🏼⏳🏔️

#motivation #transformation #fyp #viral #Fitness

interaction_stickers.text_info: As someone who has lost 120lbs so far
At my highest I was 408lbs and wouldn’t even look at the clothes in most stores because I wore a 4x/5x

I’ll never get 
over this feeling… 🥹

I know it’s probably meant
 to be oversized - 
but I don’t care. 
It fit my body.

But this cute sweatshirt 
at Sam’s caught my eye 
and I had to try it

Because this is one of the 
“normal” things for most people
 that I’ll never take for granted.
And as someone who could NEVER find clothes in regular stores - this is always a big deal

So I’ll take my Sam’s Club 
sweatshirt and wear it 
proudly tomorrow 💛

“The Call” is a new video series that reaches on-the-ground New York Times reporters and newsmakers in the middle of the biggest stories of the day.
